messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Synthetic check 'canary-eu1/response-v2' failing 6x in a row. Severity: page. PagerDuty: https://pd.redwood/INC-2026-345 · Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/canary/canary-overview

pagerduty: Page fired: INC-2026-345 — assigned to maria (oncall). Incident URL: https://pd.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-345

maria: ack — I'm on it. Quick check first. Anyone seeing customer 5xx spikes?

derek: Not in production metrics, just the synthetic probe. Grafana shows a spike of 502s from canary-eu1-route between 10:01–10:05. Looks correlated with recent canary config change.

maria: running a direct probe against the canary host now
```
curl -i -H \"Host: canary.redwood-eu\" https://synth-probe-eu1.internal/health
# HTTP/2 502
# body: upstream read failed
```

ops-bot: K8s events: deployment/canary-eu1 restarted 3x in last 12m; container inference-runtime OOMKilled (oom_kill) on pod canary-eu1-5c9d7

kate: that memory bump we deployed yesterday to the canary image could be the culprit — it changed JVM heap args and a sidecar memory limit.

maria: agreed. I'm going to roll the canary back to last known-good image (canary@sha256:abcd1234) and watch.

sre-rotation: @maria if rollback doesn't stabilize within 5m, we should fail traffic over to us-east as a precaution. I can trigger routing if needed.

maria: acknowledged. PagerDuty acked by maria at 1917629160. Initiating rollback now.

incident-bot: rollback job started. Runbook reference: https://runbooks.redwood/synth-canary/failures (step: rollback-canary-image)

maria: rollback command run:
```
kubectl set image deploy/canary-eu1 canary=registry.redwood/canary:20260227-good && kubectl rollout status deploy/canary-eu1 -w
```

kate: pods are coming up but still seeing intermittent 502s — looks like KV cache warmup causing timeouts on cold starts. Increasing replicas for faster warmup.

maria: scaling replicas to 4 to help warm cache. `kubectl scale deploy/canary-eu1 --replicas=4`

derek: observing request success % recovering on dashboard — canary 200s start returning at 1917629620. Still monitoring for a full minute.

sre-rotation: I'm preparing the failover playbook just in case. @maria if we get 2 more failures in the next 3m, I'll execute the region cutover.

maria: please hold — looks like stabilization is happening. No customer-facing errors reported in the last 15m. I'll keep PD open until we're green. Suppressing further synth pages for 10m to avoid alert noise.

oncall-next: noted — I'll pick this up for the 30m watch. Thanks for the quick rollback and scaling. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: Incident INC-2026-345 acknowledged by maria at 1917629160; escalation to next tier canceled.

maria: handoff to @oncall-next at 1917629720. Summary for the handoff: cause: recent memory/jvm sidecar tweak in canary image; mitigation: rolled back to previous image, scaled replicas to allow KV warmup; observed recovery in synth metrics; no customer-facing impact observed. Keep PD open until 1917630920 (30m from handoff).

oncall-next: taking it. I'll watch metrics and the runbook. If anything flaps, I'll re-open PD and escalate.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-2026-345 closed automatically at 1917629860 (no further pages; marked stable). Thanks everyone.
